geography.text: Natural gas input for cogeneration unit and electricity demand modelled for Switzerland. Process applicable in central European conditions.

technology.text: Single stage absorption chiller with 100 kW cooling capacity connected to a 250 kW hybrid air cooler. Seasonal performance factor (SPF) of 0.6. Supply temperature of the chilled water 6°C. Operated with heat of a temperature of 85- 100°C.
